name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every day at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      since:
        description: 'Start date for scan (ISO 8601)'
        required: false
        type: string
      last:
        description: 'Duration for scan (e.g., 24h, 7d)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '24h'
      parallel:
        description: 'Number of parallel workers'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 3
      auto_apply:
        description: 'Automatically apply blocks'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

jobs:
  detect-abuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event.inputs.auto_apply == 'true'
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
          aws-region: ${{ secrets.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Run Abuse Detection
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }}
          INPUT_SINCE: ${{ github.event.inputs.since }}
          INPUT_LAST: ${{ github.event.inputs.last }}
          INPUT_PARALLEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.parallel }}
          INPUT_AUTO_APPLY: ${{ github.event.inputs.auto_apply }}
          IS_SCHEDULED: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
        run: |
          ARGS=""
          
          # Handle --since
          if [ -n "$INPUT_SINCE" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --since $INPUT_SINCE"
          fi
          
          # Handle --last
          if [ -n "$INPUT_LAST" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --last $INPUT_LAST"
          fi
          
          # Handle --parallel
          if [ -n "$INPUT_PARALLEL" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --parallel $INPUT_PARALLEL"
          fi
          
          # Handle --auto-apply
          # Apply if explicitly set to true in dispatch, or if it's a scheduled run
          if [ "$INPUT_AUTO_APPLY" == "true" ] || [ "$IS_SCHEDULED" == "true" ]; then
            ARGS="$ARGS --auto-apply"
          fi
          
          echo "Running command: npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts $ARGS"
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts $ARGS

      - name: Apply Abuse Blocks (if needed)
        if: failure() || (success() && (github.event.inputs.auto_apply == 'true' || github.event_name == 'schedule'))
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/apply-abuse-blocks.ts
